Position: Regional Sales Manager Location: Mainland Europe Position Overview The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth, expanding market presence, and developing strategic customer relationships across the assigned territory. Key responsibilities include: Achieve and exceed annual sales targets through proactive business development and account management. Develop, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with customers, while promoting the company's brands, products, and services in a professional and ethical manner. Provide regular market intelligence, including business trends, regulatory developments, competitive activity, and industry insights within the assigned territory. Identify, qualify, and manage sales opportunities, ensuring accurate pipeline management and forecasting through the company's CRM system. Develop strategic territory plans to identify growth opportunities, improve market penetration, and maximize utilization of available company resources. Recruit, manage, mentor, and engage agents, distributors, and channel partners to support business objectives and enhance regional coverage. Establish ambitious yet achievable annual sales objectives based on installed base analysis, customer shutdown schedules, project pipelines, and key account development plans. Deliver accurate and timely sales forecasts, maintaining high standards of CRM data quality and opportunity management. Expand the company's market footprint by securing new customers, increasing share of wallet within existing accounts, and identifying new industry sectors and applications. Grow the customer base through the identification and development of MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Operations), capital project, aftermarket, and service opportunities. Collaborate with internal teams including engineering, operations, product management, and customer support to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction. Monitor and evaluate market trends, customer requirements, and competitive positioning to support strategic decision-making and territory growth. Drive profitability by focusing on high-value opportunities, effective pricing strategies, and long-term customer partnerships. Maintain a strong understanding of the company's products, solutions, and industry applications to effectively position value propositions with customers. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, customer meetings, and professional networking opportunities to enhance brand awareness and generate new business opportunities. Success Measures The Regional Sales Manager Will Be Measured On Achievement of sales revenue and profitability targets. Growth in market share and customer acquisition. Accuracy of sales forecasting and CRM management. Development and retention of key customer relationships. Expansion of distributor and agent performance. Identification and conversion of strategic project opportunities. Contribution to overall business growth and customer satisfaction within the assigned territory. Sales Manager – Gas/Industrial Solutions WEST - MEDITERRANEAN EUROPE Location Europe - Remote (preferred locations are Italy, Switzerland, or other Western and Mediterranean countries depending on territory and candidate profile) Department: Sales Reports To: Regional Director Europe West/Mediterranean Europe Employment Type: Full-Time Position Overview Picarro is seeking a motivated and customer-focused Sales Manager to join our Industrial Solutions Sales Team in Europe. The Sales Manager plays a critical role in supporting regional growth by managing and expanding existing customer relationships, ensuring successful subscription renewals, identifying account expansion opportunities, and contributing to new business development activities aligned with the regional strategy. Role Purpose Focus on Gas Business, manage customer relationships, execute regional account strategies, identify expansion opportunities, support new-business development efforts, and maintain CRM, pipeline, forecasting and account-planning discipline. Support Picarro’s Industrial Solutions market positioning and growth plan. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow existing customer relationships Support subscription renewals and customer retention Create and maintain account development plans Identify cross-sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities Execute sales activities aligned with regional objectives Maintain CRM records, forecasts and pipeline accuracy Coordinate customer activities, proposals and follow-up actions Participate in industry conferences and customer events Qualifications 3–8 years of B2B sales, account management, business development or customer success experience Strong customer orientation and relationship-building skills Excellent communication and presentation skills Experience using CRM systems Willingness to travel approximately 40–60% Career Development Opportunity Clear pathway to broader commercial and leadership responsibilities over time Joint Company growth plan working in an international environment with talented people Opportunity to gain a strong technology background on Energy Transition requirements What Success Looks Like High customer retention and successful renewals Revenue growth within existing accounts Expansion opportunities identified and executed Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline Strong customer satisfaction and stakeholder engagement About Picarro: We are the world's leader in timely, trusted, and actionable data using enhanced optical spectroscopy. Our solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including natural gas leak detection, ethylene oxide emissions monitoring, semiconductor fabrication, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, atmospheric science, air quality, greenhouse gas measurements, food safety, hydrology, ecology, and more. Our software and hardware are designed and manufactured in Santa Clara, California and are used in over 90 countries worldwide based on over 65 patents related to cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) technology and are unparalleled in their precision, ease of use, and reliability.
